proposals.evidence: Turner guru explicitly gives Kalasha gūrak heavy, Jaunsari garūo, Nepali garũo/garuṅo/garaũ/garũ and the Kotgarhi gɔrkɔ extension. The unprefixed survey forms match this family, with local vowel reduction, inflection and nasal extensions preserved. The Danuwar/Bote variants are a qualified comparison with the adjacent Nepali family, without claiming that their precise contact history is resolved.
